findings.problem: The continuity proofs for `hspatial` (lines 146-152, run once per coordinate `i`) and `hinterval` (lines 160-166) contain the same argument line for line. Both prove that `w ↦ ∑ j, if P j then (ofDelta (affineCompMap p L σ w)) j else 0` is continuous. Each applies `continuous_finsetSum`, splits the `if`, and composes `continuous_apply j` with `continuous_subtype_val` and `(affineCompMap p L q.2).continuous`. The only difference is the predicate `P`: `cast … (staircaseSpatial p k j) = i` in one and `staircaseTime k j = 1` in the other. The argument is also written out inline and depends on `change` to see through `ofDelta`, so the continuity proof is long and brittle, and any change to `ofDelta` or `affineCompMap` must be fixed in two places.
findings.proposed_change:
Add a private lemma before `chart`:

```lean
private theorem continuous_partialWeight (L : Nat) (σ : PrismRefinementWord p L)
    (P : Fin (p + 1) → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    Continuous fun w : Delta p =>
      ∑ j : Fin (p + 1),
        if P j then StandardSimplex.ofDelta (affineCompMap p L σ w) j else 0 := by
  apply continuous_finsetSum
  intro j _
  split_ifs
  · change Continuous fun w : Delta p => ((affineCompMap p L σ) w : Fin (p + 1) → Real) j
    exact (continuous_apply j).comp
      (continuous_subtype_val.comp (affineCompMap p L σ).continuous)
  · fun_prop
```

Then `hspatial` becomes `apply Continuous.subtype_mk; change …; exact continuous_pi fun i => continuous_partialWeight L q.2 (fun j => Fin.cast (Nat.sub_add_cancel hp.pos).symm (staircaseSpatial p q.1.2 j) = i)`. `hinterval` becomes `apply Continuous.subtype_mk; change …; exact continuous_partialWeight L q.2 (fun j => staircaseTime q.1.2 j = 1)`. Both uses keep their current hypotheses (`hp`, `q`, `L`) and need no new imports. The lemma would also be reusable if other charts use sums of `ofDelta ∘ affineCompMap` coordinates.
findings.benefit: The shared argument is proved once and the two uses in `chart` shrink to a few lines each. A reader sees that the spatial and interval coordinates differ only in their selecting predicate. A change to `ofDelta` or `affineCompMap` has one place to fix.
